title: Day 1
body: Your recovery journey begins today. Take it one step at a time.

title: Early Days
body: Ice and elevation are your best friends right now. Keep up the good work.

title: Getting Active
body: You're building the foundation for a strong recovery. Consistency is key.

title: Getting Stronger
body: Your muscles are remembering how to work together. Progress is happening even when you can't feel it.

title: Trust the Process
body: Healing isn't always visible day to day, but your body is working hard behind the scenes.

title: Rest Is Work Too
body: Taking it easy today isn't giving up — rest is when your body actually does the healing.

title: Small Wins Count
body: Every degree of bend, every pain-free step — these are real victories. Celebrate them.

title: Patience Is a Skill
body: Recovery moves at its own pace. Fighting it only slows things down — working with it speeds them up.

title: Your Knee Has a Memory
body: Every exercise you do today is teaching your knee how to move confidently again. The repetitions add up.

title: Your Recovery, Your Pace
body: Everyone's timeline looks different. Comparing yourself to others will only steal your progress.

title: Setbacks Are Normal
body: A harder day doesn't erase your progress. Recovery is rarely a straight line.

title: The Goal Is in Sight
body: Every session brings you one step closer to doing the things you love again. Keep showing up.

title: Listen to Your Body
body: Pain is information, not failure. If something doesn't feel right, it's okay to back off and tell your physio.

title: Stronger Than You Think
body: You chose to do the work when it would've been easy to skip. That's the mindset that gets people back.

title: First Workout Complete
body: You completed your very first workout session. The hardest step is always the first one!

title: 7-Day Streak
body: Seven days of consistent effort. Your dedication is building real results.

title: 30 Days Strong
body: One month into your recovery. You're doing amazing — keep going!

title: Ice Bag Hack
body: Frozen peas conform perfectly to your knee shape and can be refrozen multiple times. Keep two bags rotating!

title: Shower Chair Tip
body: A plastic bag secured with a rubber band keeps your dressing dry during showers. No need for a special cover.
